name: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. The shares trade 4% above the Base value. Revenue growth and the balance sheet are excellent, but earnings and cash flow have not caught up, and the two valuation methods disagree sharply. A 40% margin of safety is required, which puts the buy zone at $27.03 or below.
llms: Fast-growing defense technology manufacturer (hypersonics, drones, engines, space) with $1.4 billion of cash, valued on forward EV to sales and EBITDA after stock compensation; the two methods diverge sharply. Bear $36.84, Base $45.04, Bull $69.74. Verdict HOLD at $47.04 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $27.03.
